title: partner-cloud-marketplace-sync-weekly-prep
content:
Meeting: Weekly Partner & Cloud Marketplace Sync (prep + follow-up)
Date: 2026-03-04 (weekly)
Owner: Maya Chen (prep owner)
Attendees to invite: AWS marketplace PM, GCP marketplace partner manager, Azure marketplace rep, Jonas (sales), Priya (partner ops), Liam (tech lead)
Objective: status check on listings, outstanding certification blockers, co-sell / co-marketing asks, and next-step alignment for Q2 partner milestones. Keep to 30-40m.

Agenda (30m)
- 5m: Quick wins / updates (internal + partner)
- 10m: Marketplace listing status & certification blockers (AWS/GCP/Azure)
- 8m: Co-marketing / GTM asks and timelines (webinars, case studies, spotlight)
- 5m: Technical blockers & support (integration test failures, onboarding scripts)
- 2m: Review action items + owners

Prep notes / talking points
- Quick wins to call out:
  - AWS: listing visible in "AI & ML" category in staging; initial acceptance email from AWS on 3/01.
  - GCP: acceptance pending OSS compliance check - expected update by 3/07.
  - Azure: passed security checklist but need updated manifest for pricing SKU mapping.

- Data/metrics to share (keep slides light):
  - Avg inference latency on dedicated (p50/p95) for the marketplace deployment: 65ms / 220ms (last 2 weeks).
  - Cost-per-1k tokens estimate on Hosted vs Dedicated for typical PLG flow - bring the two-line table.
  - Early traction: 3 pilot customers onboarded via AWS listing (inbound interest form conversions: 12 -> 4 engaged).

- Key asks / asks to raise to partners:
  - AWS: prioritize production listing review queue for our SKU (we can accept reduced visibility in exchange for shorter review).
  - GCP: clarify OSS compliance checklist item 4 (license headers) - need exact required format so engineering can push changes.
  - Azure: confirm preferred SKU granularity for metering (per-token vs per-inference) and how that maps to their billing UI.

Unresolved questions / notes to self:
- Do we have final legal wording for the GCP OSS attestations? I think Legal sent a draft on 2/20 but I need to verify acceptance.
- Who is the canonical contact at AWS for escalation if listing gets stuck? Jonas had a contact (Sam) - confirm and add to invite.
- Need to confirm whether co-marketing credits can be applied retroactively to pilot customers.

Technical blockers (for the 8m tech slot)
- Integration test failure: marketplace-e2e-test failing on authentication step (token rotation edge-case). Logs show 401 on refresh flow only in staging. Action: Liam to triage with infra.
- Billing metadata missing from Azure manifest -> affects pricing display. Action: Priya to coordinate with Azure PM for schema.

Action items (follow-up owners + rough due dates)
- Send consolidated cert checklist to engineering (attach Confluence page) - Maya - due 2026-03-06
- AWS escalation: confirm Sam (AWS) contact and request expedited review - Jonas - due 2026-03-05
- Fix e2e token refresh bug in staging and run full marketplace smoke tests - Liam - due 2026-03-08
- Confirm GCP OSS attestation wording with Legal and paste final text in Confluence - Maya & Legal (Priya to ping) - due 2026-03-06
- Update Azure manifest with billing SKU mapping and share schema with Azure PM - Priya - due 2026-03-05
- Draft co-marketing proposal (1-pager + proposed dates) for partner review - Jonas & Maya - due 2026-03-09

Follow-up notes template (to use after meeting)
- Summary: 1-2 lines status (e.g., AWS listing in staging, GCP pending OSS check, Azure manifest need).
- Decisions made (if any)
- Action items (copy from above) + owners + dates
- Next meeting: propose weekly cadence; check availability for 2026-03-11

Quick script for the call (bullet prompts)
- Start: "Thanks for joining - quick context: our focus this week is unblocking certification and aligning on billing / SKU mapping so listings can go live in time for Q2 demand push."
- For each partner: one short metric, one blocker, one ask.
- Close: confirm owners & due dates, propose next sync.

Notes to self / informal scratchpad (can keep even after doc finalized)
- If AWS asks for usage telemetry, be prepared to offer aggregated, privacy-safe dashboards (p95 latencies + token counts).
- Keep a record of any "timeline promises" - avoid committing to exact launch dates without internal alignment.
- Follow-up: add meeting notes to Confluence page MARKETPLACE-OVERVIEW and tag Jonas + Priya.

Next steps after meeting (for Maya)
- Send meeting notes + action items within 24 hours (use this follow-up notes template).
- Update Confluence with final artifacts and link to PR (marketplace manifest).
- Track blockers in JIRA (create PRT- tickets if not already created).

---
Scratch / brainstorming (do not show to partners)
- Consider a "fast-track" play for partners: limited-feature listing (no metered billing) to get visible presence quickly, then migrate to full SKU metering later. Pros: faster go-live. Cons: re-listing / communication overhead.
- Could propose a joint webinar with AWS to announce listing + spotlight low-latency inference - good for pipeline.

End of doc.
